title: FMS Aqua
description: A multi-farm management system for GreenFeed’s fish farms, covering production management, planning, materials management (MM), feed and supply inventory, and Solomon integration, with a reconciliation view that checks every warehouse issue against what each pond actually consumed. Built with Claude Code as a core part of the workflow.

title: FMS
description: A multi-farm management system for GreenFeed’s pig farms, covering production, planning, materials management, orders, sales and delivery, transportation, and e-invoicing, integrated with SAP. I was one of three engineers on the Sales module, which handles everything from assigning pigs to orders, the weighing flow, and weight-based pricing and payments to issuing e-invoices, syncing with inventory and pig status in real time and sending the final transactions on to SAP.

title: Service Request Transaction
description: A microservice rebuild of the system FPT Telecom branches use for contract transactions, in a 5-person team. I worked across backend and frontend: APIs with structured logging, a shared library for logging, security, and data access, Redis caching, and React screens built from Figma designs.

title: DBL Store
description: An online store for Dragon Ball Legends game accounts: customers sign in with Google, top up points, pick an account within their budget, and receive it instantly. Built end to end, from the storefront and API to deployment.
